draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Aihole! Over 120 stone and cave temples are spread around this little village, and back in the 6th century this was where builders experimented with how a temple should look. That experimenting led straight to Pattadakal, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
draft.hungryLine: Aihole is a small village surrounded by farmland, so carry water and snacks for your temple wander.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at the Durga temple, an 11 min walk away, then the very old Lad Khan temple just south of it. Meguti Jain temple sits up on the hill about 17 minutes on foot.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Climb up Meguti Hill and sit by the Jain temple. You get a calm view over the village, farmland and sandstone hills.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Durga temple was never a Durga temple. It was built for Surya, and got its name because a fortified lookout, a durg, was built on top of it after the 13th century.

spots.name: Durga temple
spots.detail: 11 min walk · Aihole's star, with a rare rounded apsidal plan and the finest carved panels

spots.name: Chalukya Shiva Temple
spots.detail: 13 min walk · Also called Lad Khan, now dated to about the 5th century

spots.name: Meguti Jain temple
spots.detail: 17 min walk · Hilltop temple with the famous 634 CE inscription

tips.title: Start early.
tips.body: The temples are spread across open farmland and sandstone hills, so beat the midday sun.

tips.title: Dress modestly.
tips.body: Many of these are temples, so cover shoulders and knees and take shoes off where asked.

story.title: One of the oldest
story.body: The Lad Khan temple, also called the Chalukya Shiva Temple, was once thought to be from the 7th or 8th century. It's now dated to around the 5th century, making it one of the oldest Hindu temples around.

story.title: Temple lab
story.body: By the 6th century Aihole and nearby Badami became a cradle of experiments in temple design. Builders here tried out 16 types of free-standing temples and 4 types of rock-cut shrines.

story.title: A poet's inscription
story.body: The Jain poet and court official Ravikirti built the Meguti Jain temple during the reign of Pulakeshin II. His Sanskrit inscription praising the king, the Aihole Prashasti, is a key source on the early Chalukyas.

story.title: Temple for the sun
story.body: The Durga temple went up, originally dedicated to Surya. It has the biggest and most decorated relief panels in Aihole.

story.title: A fort on a temple
story.body: During wars between Hindu kingdoms and the Sultanates, a rubble lookout was built on the Surya temple, giving it the name Durga. The lookout survived until the site was rediscovered in the 19th century and has since been removed.
